3. Ondansetron (4 mg orally disintegrating tablet) - as needed for nausea associated with migraines

Ms. Krishnamurthy was advised to maintain a headache diary to track her migraine frequency, severity, and potential triggers. We also discussed the importance of regular sleep, hydration, and stress management in migraine prevention.
